subject: [PATCH v9 4/7] mm/memcontrol: check PF_MEMALLOC after trying the limits

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the handling of PF_MEMALLOC charges in the Linux kernel's memory control code. It checks for PF_MEMALLOC after trying to consume stock, rather than before, and forces a charge if it fails or hits a limit. This change is necessary because a later patch moves the memory stock into the page counter, leaving no room between consuming stock and trying limits for the PF_MEMALLOC check.
